gcp.logging.retention.note: Logging retention: logs kept in a log bucket beyond the 30 days that storage includes, billed monthly; the _Required bucket is free. The same in every location. Synced from the Billing Catalog.

gcp.logging.routing.note: Log Router: no charge for routing logs to Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Pub/Sub or another project; the destination bills what it receives (exports to Cloud Storage pay no Class A operations). From https://cloud.google.com/stackdriver/pricing: the Billing Catalog's Cloud Logging service (5490-F7B7-8DF6) lists only storage, vended log storage and retention, no routing SKU, so sync has nothing to check.

gcp.logging.storage.note: Logging storage: a one-time charge for each GiB streamed into a log bucket, which includes 30 days of storage; vended network logs are $0.25 and the _Required bucket is free (https://cloud.google.com/stackdriver/pricing). One SKU lists every log bucket location at one price, so it is read in us-central1 for all. Synced from the Billing Catalog. The price list's first tier is the per-project free grant, billed here at the first paid tier's price.
